notes.title: Quick Hits: Using the Gun
notes.content:
[h3][b]DEEP BLAST RUSH LORE: 
Your ship's machine gun is overheated and weakened, so bullets will never be as powerful as bombs.[/b] [/h3][p]If you choose to use it in LS Mode, you get extra points per hit. Pair that with blasting and gusting for maximum score![/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840"]Shoot them up in the Blast Rush LS Demo![/url] (Wow that'd be a good name for these games)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eGKwWRw-muM;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.balance_change: - Your ship's machine gun is overheated and weakened, so bullets will never be as powerful as bombs.

notes.title: Quick Hits: Flash Rush
notes.content:
[h3][b]Flash Rush is the second Blast Box minigame in Blast Rush LS![/b] [/h3][p]Only your flashlight can briefly expose cloaked enemies so they can be shot down. It's also the only part in the game where the gun is more powerful![/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840"]Try it in the Blast Rush LS Demo![/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="o19lALcVqLQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: Flash Rush is the second Blast Box minigame in Blast Rush LS!

notes.title: Quick Hits: Time Attack
notes.content:
[h3][b]Time Attack is the first of four all-new minigames in the Blast Rush LS "Blast Box!"[/b] [/h3][p]It's a unique 3-minute run where you can grab time emblems to push back the clock and stay in the game.[/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840"]Try it in the Blast Rush LS Demo![/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aH79mTYT3aE;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: - Time Attack is the first of four all-new minigames in the Blast Rush LS "Blast Box!"

notes.title: Quick Hits: Bomb Types
notes.content: [h3][b]Blast Rush LS adds 6 new bomb types to the original 3 -- a total of 9 ways to blast![/b] [/h3][p]Each ship owns their own category of bombs: the BR-15 has Direct (big and brief); the Dignity Saber has Lob (grenade/missile), and the Crystal Heron has Roll (screen-clearers that "roll" across the screen). Find what fits you best![/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840/"]Bombs D1, L2 and R3 are available to try in the Blast Rush LS Demo![/url][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="acaTZm3No1o;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: [b]Blast Rush LS adds 6 new bomb types to the original 3 -- a total of 9 ways to blast![/b]

notes.title: Quick Hits: 2-Minute
notes.content:
[h3][b]The Standard and Endurance styles in Blast Rush LS have "2-Minute" variants, challenging you to get the best scores under the time limit![/b] [/h3][p]And for BRLS, they get new dedicated music! [/p][h3]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840"]Play 2-Minute in the BRLS Demo to sample the action ahead![/url][/h3][p][/p][p]Check out a full run here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sEZZEzARokY;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: - And for BRLS, they get new dedicated music!

notes.title: Quick Hits: LS Mode
notes.content: [h3][i][b]Blast Rush LS is a shoot-em-up with infinite bombs, and "bullet hell" where the enemies are the bullets! [/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][p]Under "LS Mode" you'll find one of the two main gameplay styles, Standard: a great way to get acquainted with blasting and leaving a trail of destruction through dozens of enemy waves![/p][p]The other style is Endurance: an endless, randomized challenge that tests your survival skills! Some of these waves will seem familiar from Standard, but others will "break the rules" to keep you on your toes![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2Fd-g9221DM;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: Blast Rush LS is a shoot-em-up with infinite bombs, and "bullet hell" where the enemies are the bullets!
Under "LS Mode" you'll find one of the two main gameplay styles, Standard: a great way to get acquainted with blasting and leaving a trail of destruction through dozens of enemy waves!

The other style is Endurance: an endless, randomized challenge that tests your survival skills! Some of these waves will seem familiar from Standard, but others will "break the rules" to keep you on your toes!
